title: Book of Enoch excluded but holding truth, per Malachi Martin

tellings.quote: Catholic per Catholic teaching per Malachi Martin who was one of the per first people to read the Dead Sea Scrolls.

plain: The Book of Enoch is an ancient religious text, known in English through a translation by R. H. Charles, that was left out of the Bible. The claim is that Catholic teaching holds it still contains truth. Dylan Borland, who appeared on the show to talk about what officials told him of aliens, passes this on from the Catholic priest and writer Malachi Martin, whom Borland calls one of the first people to read the Dead Sea Scrolls, the ancient manuscripts found in caves near the Dead Sea.
